answer: Attacker cost scales linearly with fake identities, since every clone requires fresh locked value. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded registration: each agent locks collateral in shale before joining, and peers prune any identity whose bond falls below threshold. Reputation then spreads along a vine of attested interactions, and bonds vest only after a long horizon, so short-lived sybil swarms never mature into trusted peers.
